verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server for external access to the graph with authorization (logseq-docs-6/13/21/29), a plugin API (community-maintained docs at plugins-doc.logseq.com, logseq-docs-12), and a logseq:// protocol for third-party invocation (logseq-docs-22/27). These together constitute a documented programmatic surface, but there is no formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (confirmed 404 in logseq-probe-2) and no llms.txt (logseq-probe-1), and no independent evidence of AI agents actually driving Logseq via this API. Missing for 10: formal API reference/OpenAPI spec, first-party (not just community) API documentation completeness, and hands-on/independent evidence of AI-driven use.
